introHtml: Purple golf balls stand out on the course and in the office — they pair a playful color with professional branding. Whether you're outfitting a corporate tournament or handing out custom logo balls at a trade show, purple adds a memorable pop of color. Decorate with a single-color imprint or a full-color logo using pad printing. These balls work well for promotional events, client gifts, or employee swag that gets used and noticed.
